facets.name: Cold Embrace
facets.description: Still the heartbeat and vital signs, taking on the cold appearance of a corpse.
facets.dramaticFailure: Suffer one aggravated damage from coming too close to death.
facets.failure: The Uratha fails to still her vital signs.
facets.success: Appear freshly dead, without pulse or respiration. Wounds clot, the body shows the signs of a corpse, and natural regeneration stops for the duration. The Uratha can still act, but suffers a penalty of (5 − Cunning Renown) on all actions. Beings able to detect vital signs will likely mistake an active Uratha under this Facet for an undead creature.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Also reduce all damage suffered by one.

facets.name: Barghest
facets.description: Death does not put the prey beyond the hunt's reach.
facets.effect: Perceive ghosts and other disembodied undead or death-infused beings in Twilight. In Gauru, Urshul, or Urhan, spend 1 Essence per scene to attack and damage these Twilight beings. Add Glory Renown to Perception and Empathy pools against any undead. When damaging a corporeal undead in those forms, reflexively spend 1 Essence to drain one of its Willpower points; if it has no Willpower remaining, inflict two additional lethal damage instead.

facets.name: Memento Mori
facets.description: Bear the wounds of those bound to the Uratha by the pack.
facets.effect: Know exactly how much damage packmates have suffered. As a reflexive action each turn, transfer up to Honor Renown total points of bashing or lethal damage from perceived packmates to the Uratha, or transfer one aggravated damage. The wounds open immediately on the Uratha's own body; taking them can kill her.

facets.name: Bone Gnaw
facets.description: Draw knowledge and power from the marrow and fragments of the dead.
facets.dicePool: Presence + Empathy + Purity; may be opposed by Resistance
facets.activationRequirement: Devour or gnaw a relatively intact human or werewolf bone. Its age does not prevent use, and it is consumed or destroyed. Fresh bone violates the Oath of the Moon; bone stripped of meat and older than six months has lost its tempting flavor.
facets.effect: Choose one listed benefit. Only seeking a particular important secret or piece of knowledge requires the Facet's roll. The deceased's ghost may oppose that roll with Resistance if present.
facets.options:
Learn basic information about the dead: name, age, sex, illness, poison or drugs at death, broad details of their life, and approximate time and date of death; older bones give a less precise time.
On a successful Presence + Empathy + Purity roll, learn one desired secret or piece of knowledge the dead considered important in life.
From a human bone, gain one dot in the dead's highest Skill for one scene.
From a werewolf bone, gain one dot in the dead's highest Renown for one scene.

facets.name: Eyes of the Dead
facets.description: See the last moments reflected in a corpse's eyes.
facets.activationRequirement: Use on human or other remains that still have eyes. The eyes need not be entirely intact; the rest of the corpse's condition does not matter.
facets.dramaticFailure: Gain Ban: the Uratha cannot look directly into another's eyes for the Condition's duration.
facets.success: See a clear vision of the last thing the victim saw before death and sense what they felt at that time. For people appearing in the vision, learn how the victim generally felt about each and their names, if the victim knew them.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Also receive the victim's memories for Wisdom Renown minutes leading up to death.

facets.name: Primal Allure
facets.description: Beguile the prey with a predator's compelling presence.
facets.dicePool: Manipulation + Subterfuge + Cunning vs Resolve + Primal Urge
facets.activationRequirement: Socially interact with the prey for at least one turn, enough to form a first impression.
facets.dramaticFailure: The prey is unnerved. Add two Doors to attempts by the Uratha to socially influence that prey for a week.
facets.success: Gain a perfect impression (p. 164) with the prey for the scene, but only for social goals requiring immediate action, such as leaving the crowd or signing a contract. Any attempt at Social Maneuvering that would cause the prey a breaking point immediately ends the Facet and forces the prey to reassess the impression.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: The Uratha may coax the prey into an action causing a breaking point. The Facet ends after that action as the prey comes to her senses and faces the consequences.

facets.name: Glorious Lunacy
facets.description: Radiate Luna's glorious power and inspire awe in those facing the Uratha.
facets.activationRequirement: Activate when entering a form that inflicts Lunacy.
facets.effect: Inflict Awestruck on all prey instead of another Lunacy Condition.

facets.name: Lay Low the Challenger
facets.description: Establish dominance through blood and violence.
facets.dicePool: Presence + Intimidation + Honor vs Composure + Primal Urge
facets.activationRequirement: Use when damaging an opponent with a Brawl or Weaponry attack.
facets.dramaticFailure: The opponent regains one spent Willpower point as the Uratha's disdain stirs defiance.
facets.success: The opponent gains Cowed. Also add Honor Renown to the Uratha's next Presence-based dice pool this scene.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: The Uratha also regains one spent Willpower point.

facets.name: Snarl of the Predator
facets.description: A snarled demand drives the herd to obey.
facets.effect: When forcing Doors in Social Maneuvering, reduce the penalty for the number of remaining Doors by Purity Renown.

facets.name: Lead the Lesser Pack
facets.description: Bring outsiders into the hunt through temporary membership in the pack.
facets.activationRequirement: Inform the target that she is being brought into the pack; she must verbally accept, even if she does not fully understand the offer.
facets.effect: The target is a packmate for all benefits and drawbacks, including Gifts, totem boons, and Death Rage triggers. She feels loyalty and belonging, and adds the Uratha's Wisdom Renown to dice pools resisting coercion and Social Maneuvering from outside the pack. That sense of belonging may draw her back after the effect ends. The Uratha can have at most Wisdom Renown temporary pack members at once; attempts to add more fail.

facets.name: Breath of Air
facets.description: Command the air and the dancing winds.
facets.effect: Gain Influence (Air) equal to Cunning Renown. Use it as a spirit uses Influence, with this Facet's dice pool for Influence (Air) rolls.

facets.name: Catastrophe
facets.description: Unleash elemental destruction on a catastrophic scale.
facets.cost: 5 Essence per level of Influence used
facets.activationRequirement: Use together with Influence granted by another Elemental Facet.
facets.effect: Possessing this Facet also makes the Uratha unaffected by other Uratha's Catastrophe-augmented Influences.
facets.dramaticFailure: Gain Essence Overload.
facets.failure: Accumulate no successes and gain Stumbled.
facets.success: Accumulate successes. At the target, unleash the Influence across an area with a radius of twice Glory Renown in miles. Even a normally minor manifestation can cause floods, uncontrolled fires, or similar destruction at this scale.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: For the next day, use any of the Uratha's Elemental Facets' Influences without spending Essence. Further uses of Catastrophe still cost Essence normally.

facets.name: Flesh of Earth
facets.description: The earth and stone become extensions of the Uratha's body and will.
facets.effect: Gain Influence (Earth) equal to Honor Renown. Use it as a spirit uses Influence, with this Facet's dice pool for Influence (Earth) rolls.

facets.name: Tongue of Flame
facets.description: Master fire and smoke as the blaze obeys the Uratha.
facets.effect: Gain Influence (Fire) equal to Purity Renown. Use it as a spirit uses Influence, with this Facet's dice pool for Influence (Fire) rolls.

facets.name: Heart of Water
facets.description: Call waves and water, rain and rivers, to rise or recede.
facets.effect: Gain Influence (Water) equal to Wisdom Renown. Use it as a spirit uses Influence, with this Facet's dice pool for Influence (Water) rolls.

facets.name: Feet of Mist
facets.description: When the hunter becomes the quarry, every trace of her passing vanishes.
facets.effect: Attempts to track or locate the Uratha fail: she leaves no tracks, devices cannot reveal her location, and supernatural tracking or divination falters. When this causes a Clash of Wills against another supernatural tracking or locating power, apply the rote quality to the Uratha's Clash of Wills pool. This does not make her invisible; anyone encountering her can perceive her normally.

facets.name: Fog of War
facets.description: Confusion sends a bullet, message, gift, or delivery to the wrong recipient.
facets.dicePool: Wits + Subterfuge + Glory vs Composure + Primal Urge
facets.activationRequirement: Enough activity or confusion must be present for the mistake to seem plausible. The person delivering the object, such as the attacker or sender, resists the Facet.
facets.dramaticFailure: Gain Ban: the Uratha cannot willingly give any possession to another for the Condition's duration.
facets.success: A ranged attack switches to another target within Glory Renown yards of the original. The attacker rolls the attack pool with modifiers appropriate to the new target. A less lethal delivery reaches the wrong person through an unfortunate coincidence. Spend 1 additional Essence to choose the new recipient, provided that recipient is plausible for the means of delivery.

facets.name: Deny Everything
facets.description: Make evasiveness a defense against influence and interrogation.
facets.effect: Add Honor Renown to one roll to resist Social Maneuvering or a Manipulation-based action.

facets.name: Hit and Run
facets.description: Disengage from battle and leave the prey uncertain of the hunter's whereabouts.
facets.dicePool: Dexterity + Stealth + Purity vs Composure + Primal Urge
facets.effect: Interrupt an attack aimed at the Uratha before it is taken. Immediately disengage and move up to full Speed away; this may itself foil the attack. If the move breaks line of sight with all the prey, roll against the highest Composure among those who could previously see the Uratha. Interrupt only one action per turn this way.
facets.dramaticFailure: The prey know exactly where the Uratha fled and gain +2 to resist further uses of this Facet or other attempts by the Uratha to deceive them for the rest of the scene.
facets.success: The prey lose track of the Uratha's current position. Enemies whose Composure is no greater than the successes rolled gain Shadow Paranoia for Purity Renown turns.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Also immediately move up to Speed again.

facets.name: Exit Strategy
facets.description: Instinctively find an escape route or a hiding place.
facets.effect: Paying the cost immediately reveals all usable escape routes in the surroundings, including which apparent routes are blocked or lead nowhere. Alternatively, focus on a specific desired feature of a hiding place and roll the Facet's pool.
facets.dramaticFailure: The Facet leads to somewhere useless or dangerous, such as a dead end or trap.
facets.success: Instinctively learn one of the listed options. The Uratha cannot explain the details of this knowledge to others, but the Facet leads her to what she seeks.
facets.options:
The nearest safe, uninhabited hiding place within Wisdom Renown miles.
A concealed or obstacle-filled escape route imposing a penalty of Wisdom Renown on pursuers' foot chase rolls.
A route to a vehicle or a particular useful piece of equipment rated no higher than Wisdom Renown, such as a car with its keys or a crowbar.
The nearest way past a specific obstacle within Wisdom Renown miles, such as an underpass or a log across a river.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Also add Wisdom Renown to Physical pools used to escape the current surroundings, except attack rolls.

facets.name: Prey on Weakness
facets.description: Expose the vulnerabilities hidden beneath the prey's facade.
facets.dicePool: Presence + Empathy + Cunning vs Composure + Primal Urge
facets.activationRequirement: Observe one individual for at least one turn.
facets.dramaticFailure: The prey remains unreadable and gains +3 to Subterfuge rolls against the Uratha for the rest of the scene.
facets.success: Learn the prey's Blood and Bone or equivalent traits, current damage, frailties including Physical and Mental Conditions and Tilts, sickness, poison or drugs, and whether strong emotions such as anger or grief currently grip her. Gain +3 to Social rolls or Social Maneuvering pools that use this information against the prey during this scene.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Using the information in Social Maneuvering also automatically opens one Door in addition to the action's other results.

facets.name: Read the World's Loom
facets.description: Read meaningful patterns in seemingly trivial details of the surroundings.
facets.cost: 5 Essence; 3 Essence in the pack's territory
facets.dramaticFailure: Read a false message in the surroundings, such as seeing an approaching hostile pack where no threat exists.
facets.success: Learn about one meaningful event, threat, or circumstance within Glory Renown miles from signs in the surroundings. The information concerns the present or near future; anything beyond 24 hours is likely to be very vague. Choose one listed topic. If there is no meaningful answer, choose another topic instead.
facets.options:
Threats: a planned police raid, werewolves seeking confrontation, an unstable building, or a returned spirit.
The supernatural: a creature preying on residents, something dwelling in a high-rise, or a power numbing minds.
The Gauntlet: tears, stifling thickness, or spirits crossing it.
The Shadow: cultivated resonance, umia at war, or intruders.
Violence: a brewing riot, patterns in murders, or a hunt.
Conflicts: gang feuds, financial attacks, or a bitter election.
Weather: an approaching storm, lasting heat, or rain concealing murders.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Choose two topics for insight.

facets.name: Echo Dream
facets.description: Read spiritual echoes impressed into an object or place by its past.
facets.activationRequirement: Handle or touch one object or location no larger than a medium-sized room.
facets.dramaticFailure: Lose one Willpower point as the unfocused visions leave the Uratha dazed.
facets.success: Receive a clear but often highly symbolic vision of a spiritually significant event in the subject's past, such as a murder or intense emotional outburst. Echoes usually last only a few years, but especially powerful impressions may persist much longer.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: The vision becomes more literal and less symbolic. The Uratha may use Prey on Weakness or Scent the Unnatural on any characters perceived in the vision.

facets.name: Scent the Unnatural
facets.description: Smell creatures and powers that defy the natural order of Flesh and Shadow.
facets.effect: Detect supernatural creatures and effects within 10 yards per Purity Renown dot. This excludes Uratha and Gifts, and excludes spirits and their powers when in the Shadow. It can detect Ridden, Hosts, vampires, ghouls, mages, other supernatural creatures, and their active spells, items, enchantments, or powers.
facets.dramaticFailure: Gain Ban: carry a scented or perfumed object and breathe from it at least once per scene.
facets.success: Each success reveals one supernatural being or effect within range, its location, and an effect's covered area. No further nature is revealed, except that Hosts and Claimed are immediately recognized as such; neither the type of Host nor the claiming spirit is identified.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Learn the specific scent of nearby supernatural individuals or effects and easily recognize them on later encounters without using this Facet again.

facets.name: One Step Ahead
facets.description: Anticipate where the prey will move or flee next.
facets.activationRequirement: Perceive the prey, the building or location containing the prey, or a map marking the prey's current location.
facets.effect: Learn the prey's likely next steps at the observed scale. In person, identify a likely exit or patrol route; observing a building or hiding place, identify the exit used if alarmed, flushed, or lured out; on a map, sense the likely destination of flight or travel. This relies on current events and may become outdated if circumstances change dramatically.

facets.name: Lunatic Inspiration
facets.description: Become a maddening muse with a touch and whispered encouragement.
facets.activationRequirement: Touch a human or Wolf-Blooded target.
facets.dramaticFailure: Gain Ban: mark yourself with paint, color, or dye in startling patterns and seek to change those patterns each scene.
facets.success: After the prey next sleeps, gain Inspired and Madness. Nightly mad dreams spur creativity and revelation, refreshing Inspired each day for the duration. The prey is driven to complete artwork reflecting the dream-visions by the Facet's end; completing it resolves Madness. The artwork may contain a message, clue, or hint from Luna or the Lunar umia recognizable to those who know what to seek.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: The inspired human also gains Swooning toward the Uratha.

facets.name: Fearless Hunter
facets.description: Stand firm before terrifying prey and lead by example.
facets.effect: Add Glory Renown to all pools contesting mind-influencing powers and fear, and to Composure and Resolve when resisting those effects. On successfully contesting such a roll, all other packmates who can see the Uratha and are subject to that same effect automatically withstand it as well.

facets.name: Pack Triumphs Together
facets.description: Coordinate the pack into an efficient hunting machine.
facets.cost: 1 Essence per packmate affected, minimum 1 Essence
facets.effect: Activate when rolling Initiative at combat's start. After every Initiative roll, the Uratha and targeted packmates may raise their Initiative to match the highest rolled by any packmate. Alternatively, activate outside combat during a teamwork action to grant all targeted packmates 8-again on teamwork rolls toward accomplishing that action for the rest of the scene.

facets.name: Unity
facets.description: Reinforce the bonds that hold the pack together.
facets.activationRequirement: During a Social Maneuver targeting a packmate, offer support or rebuff the person attempting it.
facets.effect: The packmate adds the Uratha's Purity Renown to the number of Doors the maneuver must open to succeed. Unity may be used only once against that particular maneuver.

facets.name: Still Small Voice
facets.description: Calm words pierce the flames of Kuruth.
facets.dicePool: Presence + Persuasion + Wisdom vs Resolve + Primal Urge
facets.activationRequirement: Target any number of Uratha in Wasu-Im who can hear the speaker. Targets cannot choose not to resist, even if they wish to indulge the coming fury.
facets.dramaticFailure: The infectious nature of Kuruth forces the speaker into Wasu-Im.
facets.success: The calming words pull the targets out of Wasu-Im and return them to normal.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: All Uratha present who can hear the speaker add the speaker's Wisdom Renown to pools resisting Death Rage for the rest of the scene.

facets.name: Needle
facets.description: Conceal knowledge from the prey amid spiritual interference and ill fortune.
facets.dicePool: Manipulation + Subterfuge + Cunning vs Composure + Primal Urge
facets.activationRequirement: Choose one piece of information while in the presence of a copy, and the prey from whom it will be hidden. A fact, book, map, or timetable can be targeted.
facets.dramaticFailure: Gain Ban: carry a copy of the targeted information and closely examine it or read a fragment aloud each scene.
facets.success: The prey loses any copy carried on their person, whether by unnoticed loss, misplacement, or corrupted files. Spiritual activity and happenstance obstruct further searches: all pools to reveal or discover that knowledge suffer a penalty equal to Cunning Renown, and research times are doubled.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Double the inflicted penalty.

facets.name: This Story Is True
facets.description: Teach a useful lesson through a story whose symbolic meaning matters more than its factual truth.
facets.activationRequirement: Tell a story clearly conveying a lesson relevant to a current problem or challenge. Bestow it on the Uratha or one packmate who hears it.
facets.dramaticFailure: Gain Ban: feel compelled to speak entirely in stories and verse, even when answering simple questions.
facets.success: Grant dots equal to successes in one Skill in which the target has two or fewer dots, never raising it above five. Only one target can benefit at a time; using the Facet on another immediately removes the previous target's granted dots.

facets.name: Know Thy Prey
facets.description: Hear what the wider world knows about the prey.
facets.activationRequirement: Target any present character the Uratha can perceive. Anonymity penalizes the pool, but the target otherwise has no resistance because the answers come from the wider world.
facets.dramaticFailure: Discover the prey's names as on a success, but gain Ban: claim one of those names, answer to it, and try to mark possessions with it.
facets.failure: The Facet fails and cannot be used on the same target this scene.
facets.success: Know every name by which someone other than the prey knows them, plus any Alternate Identity or Fame Merits. Also learn every Allies, Contacts, Retainer, Resources, Staff, and Status Merit whose dots do not exceed successes rolled.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Learn one additional fact someone somewhere knows about the prey, likely valuable or relatively secret, such as compromising information or a Social Security number.

facets.name: Lore of the Land
facets.description: Draw on the bond between Uratha and territory to reveal its supernatural workings and threats.
facets.dramaticFailure: Gain Ban: seek skin contact with the ground, remove footwear, and preferably find bare earth for the toes.
facets.success: Each success reveals one rite, spiritual resonance, or other widespread supernatural effect affecting the current territory. In the pack's territory, also detect all physically present creatures within Purity Renown × 100 yards, plus threats such as fires, traps, pitfalls, and explosives. Spirits, ghosts, and other beings in Twilight are not detected.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Add Purity Renown to all rolls to navigate and move through the current territory for the rest of the scene.

facets.name: Sift the Sands
facets.description: Call on spirits to locate hidden knowledge in a collection of records.
facets.activationRequirement: Be in the presence of a store of knowledge, such as a library, secure deposit boxes, or servers, and choose a specific piece of information to seek. The assisting spirits produce visible or audible signs, such as moving books or crackling servers.
facets.dramaticFailure: Gain Ban: cannot read or understand visual glyphs and symbols, including road signs. Being read to is unsettling and provokes a desire to flee.
facets.failure: Accumulate no successes and gain Stumbled.
facets.success: Accumulate successes. At the target, immediately learn whether the information is present and receive it if so, bypassing security, locks, encryption, and other obstacles. Data arrives directly in the mind. Within one hour, touch a blank book or data storage and spend 1 Essence to immediately transcribe the information onto it.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: For one month, research using this collection proceeds at double speed and adds Wisdom Renown to the pool.

facets.name: Nature's Lure
facets.description: Entice unwary prey into the wild.
facets.dicePool: Manipulation + Survival + Cunning vs Composure + Primal Urge
facets.activationRequirement: Target an isolated person or small group numbering no more than Cunning Renown, at the edge of wilderness. Cannot affect Uratha or draw people away from a larger group. Urban parks and wasteland qualify as well as rural woodland.
facets.dramaticFailure: The prey gains Spooked, refuses the lure, and becomes aware that something called to them.
facets.success: The prey gains Lured and a strong urge to reach the wilderness's heart for the rest of the scene, drawn by something desirable, intriguing sounds, or the urge to explore. While remaining in the wilderness, the prey suffers an Initiative penalty equal to Cunning Renown.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Also impose a Perception penalty equal to Cunning Renown while the prey remains in the wilderness.

facets.name: Black Earth, Red Hunger
facets.description: Feed the earth with blood and Essence to call forth ravenous vegetation.
facets.activationRequirement: Spatter a few droplets of the Uratha's blood or someone else's onto the ground.
facets.effect: Over one minute, vegetation erupts in an area with a radius of up to Glory Renown × 10 yards. Guide the growth as desired, including climbing vines, thorn thickets, hedge mazes, or trees. Plants, moss, and fungus entirely consume dead bodies present at activation, leaving no bones. Until the next sunrise, perfectly perceive creatures with a heartbeat in the overgrowth and creatures without one that are bleeding. During any turn in which another creature is injured and spills blood among the plants, the Uratha's regeneration heals lethal damage without paying Essence.

facets.name: Knotted Paths
facets.description: Twist every escape route back toward the hunter.
facets.dicePool: Wits + Survival + Honor vs Composure + Primal Urge
facets.activationRequirement: Target prey the Uratha can perceive within an area of wilderness.
facets.dramaticFailure: The prey can leave unobstructed and gains +3 Initiative if the Uratha attacks before they leave.
facets.success: The prey cannot escape their current area for the duration, regardless of their efforts. Woodland paths, urban wasteland, and remote valley roads wind back on themselves rather than reaching the boundary.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Prey in a group quickly become separated and lose track of one another. Lone prey gain Shadow Paranoia.

facets.name: Pack Kin
facets.description: Bind a predatory animal's hunting instincts to the pack.
facets.activationRequirement: The predatory animal must at least tolerate the Uratha's presence and not be hostile. Beast Speaker from the Gift of Hunting can help.
facets.dramaticFailure: The animal becomes frightened, angry, and hostile to the Uratha, ending the Facet.
facets.failure: Accumulate no successes and gain Stumbled.
facets.success: Accumulate successes. At the target, the animal becomes a permanent, full packmate. It understands any pack member's commands, loyally obeys commands that are not obviously self-destructive, and gains +3 to resist mind-affecting supernatural powers and Conditions from outside the pack. The Uratha can have up to Purity Renown predators bound at once; each Uratha with this Facet can contribute their own group.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Facets charging Essence per targeted packmate can include the animal for free. It also gains Open, but only for the pack's totem spirit.

facets.name: Beast Ride
facets.description: Send the Uratha's spirit to inhabit an animal's mind and senses.
facets.dicePool: Wits + Animal Ken + Wisdom − animal's Resolve
facets.activationRequirement: Target one mammal, fish, bird, or reptile the Uratha can perceive.
facets.dramaticFailure: Gain Ban: adopt some mannerisms of that type of creature and find such creatures enthrallingly fascinating.
facets.success: Ride the animal's mind as long as desired, letting it act independently or controlling it directly. The Uratha cannot perceive through her own senses and appears deeply asleep. Returning to her own senses takes an instant action and ends the Facet. If the animal dies, return to the body and suffer a breaking point towards Spirit. If the Uratha's body dies instead, a fragment of her spirit is subsumed into the animal, creating a unique Claimed.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Retain some awareness of the Uratha's own surroundings and receive warning if her real body is injured.

facets.name: Incite Fury
facets.description: Provoke reckless fury with a supernaturally barbed snarl.
facets.dicePool: Manipulation + Subterfuge + Cunning vs Composure + Primal Urge
facets.activationRequirement: Target one character the Uratha can perceive who can hear the mocking or challenging snarl.
facets.dramaticFailure: The Uratha enters Wasu-Im.
facets.success: Uratha prey enter Wasu-Im; humans and other supernatural beings gain Berserk. An Uratha can be targeted only once per scene, after which their rage resists outside influence.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Add Cunning Renown to the Uratha's next pool to resist Death Rage this scene.

facets.name: Berserker's Might
facets.description: Shrug off grievous wounds with the power of rage.
facets.activationRequirement: Use once per turn while in Dalu or Gauru.
facets.effect: Either reduce damage from one source by Glory Renown, or immediately heal one physical-injury Tilt, such as Arm Wrack, Blind, or Leg Wrack. In Basu-Im, the Uratha uses this Facet instinctively and pays no Essence.

facets.name: Perfected Rage
facets.description: Channel fury to sustain Gauru longer.
facets.activationRequirement: Activate upon entering Gauru.
facets.effect: Add Honor Renown to the number of turns Gauru can be maintained.

facets.name: Slaughterer
facets.description: Draw on rage to deal even greater wounds.
facets.activationRequirement: Use in Gauru when a Brawl attack hits.
facets.effect: Add Purity Renown to the inflicted damage. In Basu-Im, the Uratha uses this Facet instinctively and pays no Essence.

facets.name: Raging Lunacy
facets.description: Turn Luna's maddening vision into a spark of uncontrollable fury.
facets.activationRequirement: Activate when entering a form that inflicts Lunacy.
facets.effect: Inflict Berserk on victims instead of another Lunacy Condition.

facets.name: Moldywarp
facets.description: Mold Dalu into a powerful burrowing hybrid.
facets.activationRequirement: Use only in Dalu.
facets.effect: The Uratha's hands become broad claws that easily tunnel through earth, rock, and concrete. Gain a tunneling Speed equal to Strength + Cunning Renown.

facets.name: Shield-Breaker
facets.description: Shatter shields and buckle armor with a powerful strike.
facets.activationRequirement: Activate when striking a foe with a Brawl or Weaponry attack.
facets.effect: Grant that attack armor piercing equal to Glory Renown.

facets.name: Entropy's Toll
facets.description: Unleash entropy through a howl that breaks stone, glass, and metal.
facets.activationRequirement: Target an object or structure the Uratha can see. The destructive howl is plainly audible to anyone nearby.
facets.dramaticFailure: Suffer one aggravated damage from the entropic energy.
facets.success: Inflict two Structure damage per success, ignoring all Durability.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: In addition to the increased damage, successes may be transferred onto other nearby objects.

facets.name: Perfection of Form
facets.description: Hone a tool to perfection with a whisper and a touch.
facets.activationRequirement: Target one held item that grants an equipment bonus.
facets.dramaticFailure: The item is destroyed or ruined beyond use.
facets.success: Increase the equipment bonus by successes rolled. The additional bonus applies only to the item's next use, after which it is lost. If damaged, the item also recovers Structure equal to successes rolled.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: The item also gains 9-again for one roll, or 8-again if it already has 9-again.

facets.name: Sculpt
facets.description: Make even rigid substances yield like clay.
facets.duration: 30 minutes; renewable for 1 Essence per 30 minutes
facets.activationRequirement: Touch one object or a component of a larger structure with Size no greater than Wisdom Renown.
facets.dramaticFailure: The Facet fails, and Sculpt cannot affect the object or structure again for one day.
facets.success: The affected material becomes as workable as clay, regardless of its substance. Shape it, make sculptures, or push aside a section of wall to open a gap. After 30 minutes it returns to its usual solidity; spending another Essence at that point maintains malleability for another 30 minutes, indefinitely while Essence lasts. Reshaped mechanical or electronic objects are unlikely to function after solidifying.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Add Wisdom Renown to all Crafts rolls to shape, sculpt, and work the softened material.

facets.name: Shadow Pelt
facets.description: Call on shadows to conceal the hunter.
facets.effect: Treat a number of Stealth rolls equal to Cunning Renown as Rote Actions.

facets.name: Predator's Shadow
facets.description: Fill the prey with fear of a hunter hidden in the dark.
facets.dicePool: Presence + Intimidation + Glory vs Composure + Primal Urge
facets.activationRequirement: Target any number of prey the Uratha can perceive.
facets.dramaticFailure: The prey gains Steadfast.
facets.success: Each prey rolling fewer successes than the Uratha gains Shadow Paranoia.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Add Glory Renown to Stealth rolls against the prey for the rest of the scene.

facets.name: Pack Stalks the Prey
facets.description: Guide packmates in the footsteps of a skilled stalker.
facets.activationRequirement: Use when the Uratha succeeds at a Stealth roll but a packmate fails.
facets.effect: The packmate automatically succeeds instead of using the original roll's result.

facets.name: The Hunter Waits
facets.description: Let patience perfect an ambush.
facets.activationRequirement: Remain relatively still and avoid drawing attention.
facets.effect: All Perception and supernatural power rolls to spot the Uratha suffer a penalty equal to Purity Renown. After successfully launching a surprise attack, add Purity Renown to Initiative.

facets.name: Running Silent
facets.description: Combine speed and silence even across treacherous terrain.
facets.effect: Reduce all falling damage and terrain-imposed Athletics and movement penalties by Wisdom Renown. Attempt Stealth rolls even while moving at full speed.

facets.name: Unchained
facets.description: Break bindings that hold the Uratha, including supernatural ones.
facets.effect: Shatter or tear free of any binding or chain, regardless of material, including supernatural or magical restraints. When this causes a Clash of Wills against a binding power, gain the rote quality on the Clash of Wills pool. Alternatively, add Cunning Renown to grappling rolls. In Basu-Im, use this Facet instinctively without spending Essence.

facets.name: Predator's Unmatched Pursuit
facets.description: Harness raw strength to leap and pursue with supernatural speed.
facets.cost: 1 Essence; activation is free upon entering Basu-Im
facets.effect: Multiply all jump distances by 1 + Glory Renown, add Glory Renown to base Speed in Urhan and Urshul, and reflexively spend 1 Essence to double Speed in any form for one turn. Upon entering Basu-Im, instinctively activate this Facet at no cost.

facets.name: Crushing Blow
facets.description: Leave the prey reeling under a punishing strike.
facets.activationRequirement: Use when a Brawl attack hits, even if it inflicts no damage.
facets.effect: Reduce the prey's Defense by Honor Renown for the next attack against them by the Uratha or a packmate only. In Hishu, the Uratha's unarmed attack inflicts lethal rather than bashing damage.

facets.name: Primal Strength
facets.description: Pour spiritual strength into blood and bone.
facets.cost: 1 Essence; activation is free upon entering Basu-Im
facets.effect: Add Purity Renown to Strength for the duration. Upon entering Basu-Im, instinctively activate this Facet at no cost.

facets.name: Rending Claws
facets.description: Strengthen claws and jaws to tear through objects and buildings.
facets.activationRequirement: While in Gauru or Urshul.
facets.effect: Ignore up to Wisdom Renown of an object or building's Durability when striking it, and inflict additional Structure damage equal to Wisdom Renown.

facets.name: Garble
facets.description: Turn modern technology against those who rely on it.
facets.activationRequirement: Target a character the Uratha can perceive.
facets.dramaticFailure: The prey gains +1 equipment bonus from every technological item used for the rest of the scene.
facets.success: Technology turns against the prey to the Uratha's benefit. Elevators deliver the prey to a floor the Uratha chooses, phone calls connect to misleading spirits, and messages contain cryptic conspiracies or viruses instead of their intended content. The prey cannot trust technological devices to obey or tell the truth.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: The first time the prey uses a technological device that should grant an equipment bonus, they suffer a dramatic failure.

facets.name: Unmake
facets.description: Command a device to tear itself apart.
facets.dicePool: Wits + Crafts + Glory vs Resolve + Primal Urge; contested only if the item is being used
facets.activationRequirement: Target one perceived item with moving parts and Size no greater than Glory Renown × 5. An unattended item does not make a resistance roll.
facets.dramaticFailure: Gain Ban: obsessively try to repair damaged objects and devices that come into the Uratha's hands, regardless of actual ability.
facets.success: The object immediately disassembles into its separate moving parts, down to ejecting a firearm's chambered round. A moving vehicle becomes a dangerous mass of hurtling components.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: The object cannot be repaired or reassembled for one month; attempts result in a dramatic failure.

facets.name: Command Artifice
facets.description: Whisper an Essence-laced command and technology obeys.
facets.activationRequirement: Target one technological device the Uratha can perceive.
facets.dramaticFailure: The device breaks irreparably and cannot be targeted with this Facet again.
facets.success: Speak a one-sentence command. The device obeys if possible, even if malfunctioning or slightly broken. Commanding it to sleep renders it entirely inert for up to Honor Renown hours.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Give a more complex command, including conditions or triggers for the device's response.

facets.name: Shutdown
facets.description: Deny the prey the protection of lights, communication, and surveillance.
facets.dramaticFailure: Gain Ban: feel compelled to turn off every technological device encountered, from lights to car engines.
facets.success: Affect the structure the Uratha occupies or an area of Purity Renown × 100 yards, whichever is larger. Lights extinguish except for occasional disorienting flickers, cameras and recording devices show static, security and detection systems fail, and phones die or produce unintelligible feedback. The Uratha may reduce the area to a particular floor, alley, or other smaller location.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: If the prey of Siskur-Dah is within the affected area, it gains Shadow Paranoia.

facets.name: Iron Slave
facets.description: Ride the senses and mechanisms of a machine.
facets.activationRequirement: Target one visible mechanical vehicle or significant piece of engineering, such as a crane or production line.
facets.dramaticFailure: Gain Ban: venerate machines of the targeted type, offer gifts to their spirits, or paint them with honoring glyphs.
facets.success: Immerse the Uratha's senses in the machine and perceive its surroundings, letting it operate normally or directly controlling it. The Uratha's own senses remain only vaguely perceptible, and the body appears dazed or asleep. Returning to the body's senses takes an instant action and ends the Facet. Destruction of the ridden machine returns the Uratha to her body and is a breaking point towards Spirit. If her body dies while riding, a spirit fragment is subsumed into the machine and may create a unique Claimed.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Remain fully aware of the Uratha's own surroundings.

facets.name: Maze Ward
facets.description: Twist a site's geometry to obstruct unwanted visitors.
facets.effect: Ward all or part of one structure, or an area with a radius up to Cunning Renown × 100 yards. Anyone other than a packmate is an intruder: attempts to navigate, pursue on foot, or track through the area suffer a penalty equal to Cunning Renown. Failing such a roll returns the intruder to the warded area's edge.

facets.name: Ward the Wolf's Den
facets.description: Seal the den against supernatural gateways and breaches.
facets.effect: Ward all or part of one structure, or an area with a radius up to Cunning Renown × 10 yards. Attempts to cross the Gauntlet or open otherworldly doorways, scrying windows, portals, or breaches suffer a penalty equal to Glory Renown. Immediately sense openings forming in the ward and reflexively spend 1 Essence to force a Clash of Wills to close one. Using the Facet at a locus in the area seals that locus for Glory Renown hours.

facets.name: All Doors Locked
facets.description: Control every threshold in a building or vehicle.
facets.activationRequirement: Touch or be inside the building or vehicle.
facets.effect: Immediately know every door, window, and entryway's location and whether it is open or closed. With a thought, open or seal any of them, including locking them fast if desired.

facets.name: Predator's Claim
facets.description: Mark a warded area with the Uratha's spiritual dominance.
facets.effect: Ward an area with a radius up to Purity Renown × 10 yards. Increase the Uratha's honorary Spirit Rank by two for attacking spirits within the area. This may raise the honorary Rank above five, but still does not permit physically challenging spirits of Rank six or greater.

facets.name: Boundary Ward
facets.description: Sense a chosen kind of being crossing a ward's border.
facets.effect: Ward all or part of one structure, or an area with a radius up to Wisdom Renown × 100 yards. Within the pack's territory, the radius may instead reach Wisdom Renown miles. Choose a type of being, such as humans, Uratha, Claimed, Hosts, spirits in Twilight, or other supernatural beings. Sense when they enter and roughly where they crossed, but do not track them after entry. Detecting humans in a crowded city can produce a constant flood of unhelpful warnings.

facets.name: Cloak of Mist and Haze
facets.description: Howl up a haze that obscures sight and muffles sound.
facets.dramaticFailure: Gain Ban: desire silence and refuse to speak.
facets.failure: Accumulate no successes and gain Stumbled.
facets.success: Accumulate successes. At the target, mist, dust, or a sandstorm descends as appropriate to the local climate. All auditory and visual Perception rolls and ranged attack rolls affected by the haze suffer a penalty equal to Cunning Renown. The source does not specify the affected area's extent.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: Visibility barely extends beyond arm's reach. A successful Wits + Survival − Cunning Renown roll is required to avoid getting lost in the affected area.

facets.name: Heavens Unleashed
facets.description: Call a thunderstorm with torrential rain and rolling lightning.
facets.dramaticFailure: Gain Ban: feel compelled to be loud and constantly make noise, breaking any silence encountered.
facets.failure: Accumulate no successes and gain Stumbled.
facets.success: Accumulate successes. At the target, a violent downpour and lightning fill the area, even if clouds must rush in from previously clear skies. Characters in the storm suffer Speed and Initiative penalties equal to Glory Renown. Cloak of Mist and Haze used during the storm makes the deluge overwhelm the senses. Rain may cause floods, property damage, and serious consequences through repeated use. The source does not specify the affected area's extent.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: The storm also penalizes use of Allies, Contacts, Retainer, Staff, and Status to obtain aid for the duration. The source does not specify this penalty's value.

facets.name: Hunt Under Iron Skies
facets.description: Remain undaunted by storms, frost, and scorching heat.
facets.effect: Reduce all penalties from weather or environmental conditions, including Environmental Tilts, by Honor Renown. Suffer no penalties from the Uratha's own Weather Facets. Spend 1 Essence per packmate to let them ignore those Weather Facets for one scene as well.

facets.name: Grasp of Howling Winds
facets.description: Turn a howl into a battering blast of Essence-laced wind.
facets.activationRequirement: Target one prey the Uratha can perceive.
facets.dramaticFailure: Gain Ban: cannot remain still and must keep moving.
facets.success: Howling winds batter the prey, imposing a penalty equal to Purity Renown on Speed and all Physical pools for the duration or until the prey escapes the Uratha's view.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: When the Facet first takes effect, also move the prey directly away from the Uratha by up to twice Purity Renown in yards.

facets.name: Hunt of Fire and Ice
facets.description: Sap the prey's strength with extreme heat or cold.
facets.dramaticFailure: Gain Ban: carry a source of extreme heat or cold at all times.
facets.failure: Accumulate no successes and gain Stumbled.
facets.success: Accumulate successes. At the target, impose Extreme Cold or Extreme Heat, according to the local area's normal climate, over an area with a radius up to Wisdom Renown miles.
facets.exceptionalSuccess: The heat or cold also obstructs the prey in other ways, such as freezing a getaway car's engine or spoiling a needed water supply.
